messages:
Jen: heads-up — model-serving tail-latency alert (service=model-serving, alert=high_tail_latency) has been really noisy since ~02:15 UTC, ~30 alerts in last 2h. looks tied to the nightly feature-batch job hitting production traffic paths.
Sam-Oncall: thanks, jen. do you have a link to the dashboard or the alert query?
Jen: dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/model-serving/latency-overview?orgId=1
Jen: alert rule: `sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{le=\"1.0\",job=\"model-serving\"}[5m])) by (instance)` — roughly fires when p95 > 800ms for >1m (old rule).
Alex: that rule is pretty sensitive to short spikes. suggestion: change to p95 > 900ms sustained >5m OR p99 > 1200ms. also add a suppression window for the nightly batch between 02:00-03:00 UTC.
Maria: +1 on suppression window. the batch job is expected to spike connectors for a few mins. alternatively we can add a tag on requests from batch so alert ignores them. which is easier?
Sam-Oncall: quick path: temporary mute for the policy during 02:00-03:00 UTC today and tomorrow, then we can iterate on the rule. can someone push the mute?
Alex: I can create a short mute in PagerDuty/AlertManager: add an inhibition for alertname=high_tail_latency with matchers environment=prod and source=batch=true. here's a proposed Alertmanager silence YAML:```
# silence to suppress nightly batch noise
matchers:
  - name: alertname
    value: "high_tail_latency"
  - name: environment
    value: "prod"
  - name: source
    value: "batch"
startsAt: 2025-10-10T02:00:00Z
endsAt:   2025-10-10T03:00:00Z
createdBy: "Alex"
comment: "Temporary mute for nightly batch while we tune thresholds"
```
Sam-Oncall: perfect. can you add a note in the alert rule ticket so we don't lose context? ticket #INF-3216.
Jen: done — added comment and linked graphs. also the batch can be modified to add header `X-Request-Source: batch` if we decide to go the tagging route.
Maria: for long-term, prefer changing alert to p99 > 1200ms sustained 10m and use a separate regression alert for p95 spikes. that keeps noise low but surfaces sustained regressions.
monitoring-bot: alert history summary: high_tail_latency — 32 fires in last 2h, avg duration 1.1s, 78% from batch path (identified by request path /batch/ingest).
Sam-Oncall: I'll apply the temporary mute now and follow up with a PR to change thresholds to p99 > 1200ms sustained 10m. tagging this thread for handoff: @Alex to apply mute, @Sam-Oncall to update ticket, @Maria/ Jen to own post-mortem if needed. :thumbsup:
Jen: thanks all — appreciate the quick triage. will monitor and report back in this thread. :eyes:
